=== Move up swaps with the previous sibling and carries the subtree
--- given
- a
  - a1
- b‸
  - b1
--- when command move-up
--- then
- b‸
  - b1
- a
  - a1

=== Move up from the first position joins the previous parent as its last child
--- given
- p
  - q
- r
  - s‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
- p
  - q
  - s‸
- r

=== Move up at the top of the list does nothing and swallows the key
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when command move-up
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Move down swaps with the next sibling and carries the subtree
--- given
- a‸
  - a1
- b
  - b1
--- when command move-down
--- then
- b
  - b1
- a‸
  - a1

=== Move down from the last position joins the next parent as its first child
--- given
- p
  - q‸
- r
  - s
--- when command move-down
--- then
- p
- r
  - q‸
  - s

=== Move down at the bottom of the list does nothing and swallows the key
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- when command move-down
--- then consumed
- a
- b‸

=== Move up keeps the folds of the moved item and of its neighbour
--- given
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b‸ ⊟
  - b1
--- when command move-up
--- then
- b‸ ⊟
  - b1
- a ⊟
  - a1

=== Move down keeps the folds of the moved item and of its neighbour
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - a1
- b ⊟
  - b1
--- when command move-down
--- then
- b ⊟
  - b1
- a‸ ⊟
  - a1

=== Move up into a folded uncle unfolds it
--- given
- p ⊟
  - q
- r
  - s‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
- p
  - q
  - s‸
- r

=== Move up renumbers an ordered list
--- given
1. a
2. b‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
1. b‸
2. a

=== Move up into the previous parent takes that parent's indent step
--- given
- p
    - q
- r
  - s‸
--- when command move-up
--- then
- p
    - q
    - s‸
- r

=== Move down keeps the cursor on its character
--- given
- ab‸c
- d
--- when command move-down
--- then
- d
- ab‸c

=== Move up carries the notes lines
--- given
- a
- b‸
  a note
--- when command move-up
--- then
- b‸
  a note
- a

=== Move up on a first child with no previous parent swallows the key
--- given
- p
  - q‸
--- when command move-up
--- then consumed
- p
  - q‸

=== Move down from a first child past the parent's siblings
--- given
- p
  - q‸
  - r
- s
--- when command move-down
--- then
- p
  - r
  - q‸
- s
